theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_scl_scalar_strip_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a D L y₀ : ℝ) (F H : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < a → 0 ≤ D → 0 ≤ L → 1 ≤ y₀ → ContinuousOn H {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → HasDerivAt F (H z) z) → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.re → z.re ≤ L → y₀ ≤ z.im → ‖H z‖ ≤ D * (1 + z.im) ^ n * Real.exp (-a * z.im)) → ∃ b : ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.re → z.re ≤ L → y₀ ≤ z.im → ‖F z - b‖ ≤ (D * (∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (1 + s) ^ n * Real.exp (-a * s))) * (1 + z.im) ^ n * Real.exp (-a * z.im)
theorems.natural_summary: Vertical integral estimates give limits with the stated tail bound; horizontal decay identifies a common limit throughout the strip.
